hero.heading: Visit the club
hero.intro: New and visiting players are welcome. Get in touch if you’d like help choosing a session.

venue.heading: Fleur Freame Lesser Hall
address: Corner Forrest Road and Marmion Avenue
venue.detail: Air-conditioned venue with comfortable seating and free parking.

arrival.heading: A few useful details
items: Please be seated 15 minutes before the session.
Session fees are $4 for members and $6 for visitors.
Visitors are welcome at our regular sessions.

contact.heading: Contact the club
contact.text: Ask about visiting, membership or which session might suit you.
